title: An image sent right after a text update fails with sendFailed
claim: The glasses-ui skill says to serialize all bridge calls, awaiting each before the next. Nothing official asks for a pause between a text update and an image send.
actual: One report on SDK 0.0.11 sees updateImageRawData return sendFailed when it follows a textContainerUpgrade with no pause, although all calls already ran one at a time through a single promise chain. The reporter puts it down to Bluetooth contention. Waiting 500 ms after the last text update avoided it; no shorter pause was measured. SDK 0.0.14 added a 100 ms hold between image sends, per the display page and the docs changelog. Neither says whether the hold covers a text update followed by an image.
impact: Apps that update text and images together lose some image frames, with no error beyond sendFailed.
workaround: Wait about 500 ms after the last textContainerUpgrade before calling updateImageRawData.

evidence.note: Stated in passing in a report on the exit dialog. Four text and two image containers, PNG payloads.
